changelog: - **The marketing host stops serving the internship product's pages** (#2540). The terminology overlay renames a word — "candidate" becomes "lead" — which works where the sentence is the same sentence in both products. It cannot rewrite a page whose entire content belongs to one of them, and six of them were being served on the marketing host untouched: `/features` opened with **"InternshipCRM neler yapabilir"** and went on to list self-service mentee applications and weekly internship reports; `/pricing` carried **"Fiyatlandırma — InternshipCRM"** in the tab title and explained a price metered in matched mentor/mentee pairs; `/release-notes` published 202 lines of the internship changelog; `/for-companies`, `/apply-as-mentor` and `/projects` are the internship front door and a showcase of intern projects — the last of which MARKETING does not even carry the capability for. A visitor reached the first two from this host's own header. They now **404** on any vertical but INTERNSHIP (`src/lib/verticalPage.ts`), a 404 rather than a rename because fluent copy about a product the visitor did not come for is worse than no page, and rather than a redirect because the page genuinely does not exist for them. The chrome loses them in the same change — header, footer, the landing's "all features" and transparency links, the sign-in page's mentor invitation, and the sidebar version chip, which now reads as text instead of pointing at the other product's changelog. Measured on a marketing host before and after: **from ~270 visible lines naming the wrong product down to 21**, all of which are legal/policy copy that needs its own wording (follow-up #2541). The internship host is untouched and asserted to be: every one of the six pages still returns 200 there, in the same regression test.
